definitions.explanation: Letters, packages, and other items sent through the postal system. The standard term for physical mail.

examples.japanese: {郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
⟦{不在|ふざい}→不在：11302_fuzai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}れなかった→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: I was out and couldn't receive the mail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{仕分|しわ}け→仕分け：07917_shiwake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: A large volume of mail arrives every day, so sorting it is quite a task.

notes:
The standard term for physical mail of all types — letters, packages, postcards, etc. More formal and comprehensive than ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧ (letter) or ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧ (package).

FORMS:
⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧ (postal service) + ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (item, thing)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: mail arrives
- {郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧: to deliver mail
- {郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{転送|てんそう}→転送：14792_tensou⟧: mail forwarding
- ⟦{書留|かきとめ}→書留：00150_kakitome⟧{郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}: registered mail
- {郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive mail
